ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 75-80% of the central surface area, bounded by a low-intensity (black) perimeter along the leading and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black banding is present along the entire trailing edge and tips. A singular, distinct high-contrast circular black focal spot is located in the upper-median quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped median notch with a narrow vertex and high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern visible along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is greatest on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal circular structures (barnacles) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. One isolated circular dark spot on the left lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-pixel, near-vertical and diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) are clearly visible on the right lobe; less prominent vertical linear marks are present on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips, creating an irregular, raised 2D profile and concentrated pixel-level texture variations.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, isolated dark-pixel clusters (dots) near the trailing edge of the right lobe within the high-intensity field.
